name: impactRecords
title: Impact records
description: Optional table linking an economic action to conservation activity and evidence in this package. Status describes the allocation, not a verified environmental outcome. Intended for CMS interchange (e.g. ArtInStack), not as a scientific core resource.

fields.name: impactRecordID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the impact record.

fields.name: sourceID
fields.description: Identifier of the source transaction in the originating system.

fields.name: campaignID
fields.description: Commercial or fundraising campaign the action supported.

fields.name: activityID
fields.description: Conservation activity or survey the amount was allocated toward. Do not infer this from campaign association alone.

fields.name: status
fields.description: State of the allocation, not proof that a conservation outcome occurred.

fields.name: allocatedAt
fields.description: Date and time the allocation was recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: evidenceObservationIDs
fields.description: Observation identifiers offered as linked evidence. Pipe-separated. Only list observations that are actually attached.

fields.name: impactRecordComments
fields.description: Comments. Do not use this field to claim outcomes that are not evidenced.
